directives.name: BaseInput
NumberFilterDirective

components.name: InputNumberComponent
components.template:
<mat-form-field>
    <mat-label>{{ label() }}</mat-label>
    <input
    type="text"
    matInput
    [placeholder]="placeholder()"
    [value]="value()"
    [disabled]="disabled()"
    (input)="handleInput($event)"
    (blur)="handleBlur()"
    [min]="min()"
    [max]="max()"
    [isInteger]="isInteger()",
    vnNumberFilter
    />
    @if (hint()) { <mat-hint>{{ hint() }}</mat-hint> }
    <mat-error>Invalid Input</mat-error>
  </mat-form-field>

components.name: InputTextComponent
